<think>**Choosing one-hot timing**

**Refining one-hot decodes**

</think>

{
  "candidate_rtl": "module mux_large (
    input [7:0] block_a, block_b, block_c, block_d, block_e,
    input [7:0] block_f, block_g, block_h, block_i, block_j,
    input [3:0] sel,
    output reg [7:0] block_out
);
    wire en_a, en_b, en_c, en_d, en_e;
    wire en_f, en_g, en_h, en_i, en_j;

    // Decode the default directly rather than complementing all other cases.
    assign en_a = (sel == 4'b0000) |
                  (sel[3] & (sel[2] | sel[1]));
    assign en_b = (sel == 4'b0001);
    assign en_c = (sel == 4'b0010);
    assign en_d = (sel == 4'b0011);
    assign en_e = (sel == 4'b0100);
    assign en_f = (sel == 4'b0101);
    assign en_g = (sel == 4'b0110);
    assign en_h = (sel == 4'b0111);
    assign en_i = (sel == 4'b1000);
    assign en_j = (sel == 4'b1001);

    always @(*) begin
        block_out = ({8{en_a}} & block_a) |
                    ({8{en_b}} & block_b) |
                    ({8{en_c}} & block_c) |
                    ({8{en_d}} & block_d) |
                    ({8{en_e}} & block_e) |
                    ({8{en_f}} & block_f) |
                    ({8{en_g}} & block_g) |
                    ({8{en_h}} & block_h) |
                    ({8{en_i}} & block_i) |
                    ({8{en_j}} & block_j);
    end
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The default block_a selection can introduce a wide complement-of-decodes path before the output gating. Select decode fanout and the ten-way data merge are the other likely timing limits.",
  "rewrite": "Use parallel one-hot data gating and directly decode block_a for select 0 and selects 10–15. This exposes a shallow default-selection expression without adding a priority mux chain.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to improve the default-selection path if the baseline retains complement-of-decodes logic. Overall mapped arrival improvement is unmeasured and may be small if ABC already derives equivalent logic.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Shared select decodes drive eight data-bit gates each. Area should remain broadly comparable to a decoded mux implementation, but compliance with the 1006.089920 um^2 cap and zero electrical violations requires the specified mapping and timing checks; neither has been measured here.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module name, port ordering, unsigned widths, and combinational output-reg interface. Selects 0–9 choose block_a through block_j respectively; selects 10–15 choose block_a. Exactly one enable is asserted for every two-state select. No state, latency, assumptions, includes, or dependencies are introduced. Four-state X/Z propagation is not claimed to match."
}
